messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

My redline on the Particulars is attached. Two substantive changes: (1) I've changed the duration of the first excursion from 'nine hours' to 'eleven hours' to match the re-read of the data logger - please double-check against HPL-003; and (2) I've added a gross-negligence limb to the 11.3 plea, picking up Harriet's framing. Everything else is tidying.

Elena
